turns.text: Looking at the scene first, so I know which cube you mean and how big it is before I round anything off. A fillet that is too large for the edge would fail, so I will size it from the cube's own dimensions.
Rounding the top edge with a 2 mm fillet, which is small enough for any of the standard cubes in the Library.
Rounded the top edge of the cube with a 2 mm fillet.
